ffpi_scale: 1-10, higher = greater flash-flood potential (not a probability)
event_prob_note: P(rainfall-triggered mass movement) from XGBoost trained on 206 real recorded disasters (NASA Global Landslide Catalog, 1970-2019). Spatially blocked CV ROC-AUC 0.82. Landslides overlap flash floods without being identical.
model_note: Legacy: P(elevated hazard) from XGBoost trained on the state hazard atlas; spatial-CV ROC-AUC 0.66, dominated by elevation. Superseded by event_prob.
